name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages a multi-virtual-host Nginx server with SSL termination across three named subdomains, including package installation, vhost configuration, TLS setup with self-signed certificates, security hardening headers, UFW firewall management, fail2ban, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures a dual-layer caching stack with both Memcached and Redis, including password authentication for Redis and a post-configuration patch to remove deprecated Redis directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a full-stack FastAPI Python web application with a PostgreSQL backend, including git-based deployment, Python virtual environment setup, systemd service management, and database/user creation.
